title: Why do VIP campaigns underperform?
instructions: Our VIP early-access campaigns keep coming in under forecast even though these are supposedly our best customers. Marketing blames the creative. Look into it before we rebrief the designers.

parts.segment.json: corrected VIP segment definition as JSON, valid against the segment schema

criteria.text: Identifies the segment-definition flaw: seg_vips has no engagement or suppression filter.
Quantifies the dead weight in the VIP segment (share suppressed, bounced, or 12-month-unengaged), within tolerance.

extract.hint: the claimed percentage of the VIP segment that is dead weight (suppressed or unengaged)

criteria.text: Shows per-engaged-member performance is actually fine, exonerating the creative.
Corrected segment definition is logically valid JSON against the segment schema and excludes suppressed and 12-month-unengaged profiles while keeping the ltv>$500 bar.
Proposes a tiered VIP definition using LTV plus engagement.
Flags implications for other segments sharing the same pattern.
